title: Lane workers see the enforced standards gates before work, not only at Stop
body:
Why: Fable 1115f slice 3; workerRecords drops enforced records, so the brain teaches only through a refused Stop.
Outcome: a separate worker-packet block of at most 150 tokens lists the stack-applicable enforced floor and finish records and the single krn standards check command; frozen FR-40 arms stay untouched.
Files: src/brain/worker-packet.ts, the lane brief caller, tests.
Proof: a unit test, plus one PHP row rerun with drain 0 and no more turns than 7880a60.
